s.note: the bar where they sing to Charlie
s.how: Dry 1kg chicken wings overnight and bake at 220C for 45 minutes. Toss in 80ml hot sauce melted with 60g butter and 1 tbsp honey. Serve with 80g blue cheese mashed into 150g sour cream and celery sticks.

Whisk 150g flour with 250ml cold lager. Dip 500g flathead strips and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Mix 150g sour cream with lime. Serve in 12 warm tortillas with shredded cabbage, diced tomato and onion.

m.note: Maverick turns up at Charlie's for dinner
m.how: Marinate 1kg chicken thighs in lemon, 3 garlic cloves and oregano for an hour and grill until charred. Toss tomato, cucumber, red onion, olives and 150g feta for a Greek salad. Serve with 4 warm pita.

w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk in 250g sugar and 3 eggs, then fold in 80g flour and 30g cocoa. Bake at 170C for 25 minutes. Cut into rectangles and drizzle with 80g chocolate melted with a knob of butter.

d.how: Stir the juice of 4 lemons with 80ml sugar syrup and 200ml water and freeze in a shallow tray for 3 hours, scraping with a fork every hour into a slush. Put four glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes. Spoon the lemon slush into the frosted glasses and top each with 250ml ice-cold lager.
